months.note: 봄과 가을에 지나가며, 번식지에서는 6월께 알을 낳는다.

summary: 봄과 가을에 한반도 전역을 지나가는 흔한 나그네새로, 숲속에 산다. 숲속 땅 위에서 먹이를 찾는 때가 많지만 나무 위에서 찾기도 하며, 곤충과 잡초 씨를 즐겨 먹는다. 구북구 동부, 아무르, 우수리, 만주 북부·동부 등지에서 번식하며 한배에 알을 3개쯤 낳는다. 중국 남부, 윈난, 일본, 미얀마 등지에서 겨울을 나고 한국, 만주, 중국 북부 등지를 지나간다.

art.subject: Tristram's Bunting (Emberiza tristrami), adult male in breeding plumage, as seen on Korean woodland floors during spring migration in late April and May: black crown with a clear white median crown stripe; dirty-white supercilium; black ear coverts; dirty-white submoustachial (malar) stripe; black chin and throat; mantle and back olive-brown to warm brown with blackish-brown shaft streaks; rump unstreaked rufous-chestnut; wings brown with buff-edged coverts and tertials; breast and flanks washed buff with diffuse brownish streaks; belly white; tail dark brown. Bill small and conical, upper mandible dark grey, lower mandible pinkish; iris brown; legs flesh-pink.
art.pose: foraging on the forest floor, side view
art.scene: Korean spring migration: shady woodland floor with leaf litter; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male breeding, side view on the ground: black crown with a clear white median stripe, dirty-white supercilium and malar stripe, black ear coverts and black throat, brown back with blackish streaks, chestnut rump, buff breast, white belly, flesh-pink legs
adult male breeding, head detail in side view: boldly striped black-and-white head with black throat, small conical bill dark grey above and pinkish below, brown eye

adult female, side view on the ground: blackish-brown crown sides with a buff median stripe, brown ear coverts, buffish-white supercilium and malar stripe, pale buff chin and throat, streaked brown back, chestnut rump, flesh-pink legs
art.build: Small, slim woodland bunting, 13–14cm, about the size of a sparrow but slimmer and longer-tailed. Rounded head without a crest, short neck. Bill small and conical, shorter than the head. Legs short, flesh-pink. Feeds quietly on the shaded forest floor among leaf litter and flies up to low branches when disturbed. At rest the wingtips reach only the base of the tail. Tail medium-long, slightly notched, dark brown.
avoid: Do not add any yellow to the supercilium or throat; that is Yellow-browed or Yellow-throated Bunting.
Do not give it a crest; the crown is rounded with a flat white central stripe.
Do not paint the breeding male's throat white; the chin and throat are black, framed by the pale malar stripe.
Do not paint dark legs; they are flesh-pink.
